automated.summary: PREFLIGHT-1 (grantable facade tools + single-event async actionable creation card + declare-at-creation guidance) verified. Full verify.py passed (typecheck, architecture, format, dual-runtime, full unit suite). Focused suites: runner+application (104 files/1408 tests) and application+jobs (123 files/1558 tests) green. The agent-runner-ipc integration test spawns the real runner subprocess and proves a scheduled WebSearch (facade) miss is now grantable (request_access kind:tool, grantable:true) end to end. Live regression: the KnackLabs scheduled job's granted facade tools still authorize via reviewed_rule; a gog RunCommand pause observed was a pre-existing matcher/command-quoting issue (unquoted range arg), not touched by this change.
tests_added_or_updated: apps/core/test/unit/shared/tool-execution-policy-service.test.ts: canonical facade tools (WebSearch/WebRead/FileRead/Browser/FileWrite/FileEdit) become grantable request_access kind:tool; third-party MCP + locked stay non-grantable; browser.use branch preserved.
apps/core/test/unit/application/setup-pause-prompt.test.ts: facade blocker raises the actionable Allow-for-future grant and appends the canonical job requirement.
apps/core/test/unit/application/job-management-create.test.ts (new): a blocked job at creation dispatches the notification port exactly once; falls back to the passive event when no port is wired.
apps/core/test/unit/application/jobs-use-cases.test.ts + jobs/ipc-scheduler-adapter-contract.test.ts: single-event creation notification wired for both Control and IPC creation paths.

apps/core/test/unit/application/prompt-profile-service.test.ts (new): the compiled full-access prompt instructs declaring a scheduled job's tools at creation (proves the guidance is live, not dead text).
apps/core/test/unit/runner/agent-runner-ipc.test.ts: scheduled WebSearch is now a grantable facade tool (updated recovery + event assertions).

automated.pass_fail_summary: verify.py: passed (typecheck, architecture, format, dual-runtime, full unit suite).; runner+application suites: passed, 104 files, 1408 tests.; application+jobs suites: passed, 123 files, 1558 tests.; agent-runner-ipc integration: passed; scheduled WebSearch facade miss => grantable request_access kind:tool end to end.
remaining_gaps: The atomic notify-claim hardening for the sub-second creation-vs-scheduler race is deferred (D-0053); the check-then-mark dedup remains best-effort and is near-unreachable for normal future-scheduled jobs.
A live Part A end-to-end button tap was not exercised (requires an ungranted facade tool on the running agent); the runner IPC integration test covers the grantable path.
A pre-existing gog RunCommand matcher limitation (unquoted space-containing range arg does not match the granted rule) is out of PREFLIGHT-1 scope.
